name: Cargo Bicycle
description: A heavy-duty bicycle with an attached cargo box or flatbed, human-powered or electric-assisted. The cargo bike is the vehicle of Tier 1 commerce — if you're selling something, fixing something, or delivering something in the Shelf or the Narrows, you're probably pedaling a cargo bike to do it. They're slow, heavy, exhausting, and absolutely essential. The people who ride them are the muscles of the street economy, burning calories they can barely afford to replace.
propulsion: Human power with optional electric assist motor
cost: Φ50-200 depending on condition and assist motor
armament: None. A heavy bike lock on a chain.
common_usage: Delivery, mobile vending, repair work, family transport, hauling anything that needs moving.
story_hooks: A cargo bike rider's daily route takes them through every district in the city and they notice patterns no one else does — because no one else sees the city at pedaling speed
Cargo bikes are being confiscated by security forces as 'unregistered vehicles,' choking Tier 1 commerce
